basics.name: Anand Bhaskaran
basics.label: AI Full-Stack Engineer | Fintech & Trading Systems | TypeScript, Java, PostgreSQL
basics.summary: AI-native full-stack engineer with 13+ years shipping production software end to end for 10M+ users: TypeScript and Java backends, Vue frontends, PostgreSQL at scale. Deep in financial markets: I run my own algo-trading signal platform (PulseView) and serve as technical mentor to OptAlpha, advising them on scaling high-frequency algorithmic trading systems in production. Currently building production multi-agent AI systems at LumApps that 2x outbound conversions and forecast $1M in quarterly revenue. Remote for 7+ years, running my own forward deployed practice (Anand Creations) embedded directly with client engineering teams.

work.name: LumApps
work.summary: Owns AI transformation end-to-end, from production AI agent architecture to company-wide governance and sales enablement strategy. Reports directly to C-level on outcomes.
highlights: Built and deployed production multi-agent workflows for outbound sales on Python, LangGraph and Google ADK over GCP Vertex AI, using ReAct, self-reflection and hierarchical delegation, with tools exposed over MCP servers and agent state streamed to the UI over AG-UI. 2x open rates, 2x approved opportunities, 2 to 3 hours saved per rep per day. Forecast: $4M in approved opportunities per quarter; at 25% conversion, $1M in quarterly revenue.

Designed AI Brain, a temporal knowledge graph on Graphiti and Neo4j that unifies 5+ silos (Salesforce, HubSpot, Pendo, conversation transcripts, product usage) into one time-aware memory every agent reads and writes. Event-driven ingest over Pub/Sub, a query and write-back contract per agent, and a freshness layer that flags stale facts, grounding RAG retrieval to cut hallucinations.

Led technical discovery through production: agent architecture, eval pipelines, agent tracing (LangSmith), tool-selection tuning, and cost-per-request instrumentation, with on-call for global production systems. Reports directly to C-level on outcomes, not progress.

work.name: Beekeeper AG
work.summary: Technical lead who operates like a founding engineer. Owns the problem, designs the solution, ships to prod, and stays accountable to the metric. Built AI-powered products used by millions while growing the engineering team around me.
highlights: Architected Employee Referral System end-to-end, owning both the Vue frontend and Java/PostgreSQL backend. Became the platform's top revenue channel ($1.5M+ generated, $500K ARR). Designed for 99.99% SLA because customer trust is measured in uptime.

Designed distributed templating engine that cut customer setup time 90%. Powers 15% of all platform assets for 10M+ users. Owned architecture end-to-end: robust, modular, performant by design, not by accident.
Replaced $337K in annual vendor translation costs with an LLM pipeline built in 6 weeks. 12K+ assets translated, product team now iterates without external gatekeepers.

work.name: Tenity
work.summary: Technology panelist and mentor for seed-to-VC stage startups. Evaluates technical architecture and advises on AI adoption, engineering culture, and building systems that scale.
highlights: Mentored Opt Alpha on scaling high-frequency algorithmic trading systems in production.
Evaluated 20+ startups on technical architecture, scalability, and AI readiness to inform seed-to-VC investment decisions.

work.name: Dronistics
work.summary: Founding engineer for an autonomous drone delivery system. Built everything from scratch: architecture, infrastructure, APIs, and the algorithms that made 500+ real-world deliveries possible.
highlights: Shipped end-to-end autonomous drone delivery platform (Vue/Java/PostgreSQL). 500+ successful deliveries, every flight a live UX test for autonomous systems in the real world.
Engineered real-time flight control APIs and logistics optimization algorithms. 40% faster deliveries, 99.5% safety record, zero incidents.

_jobApplication.jobDescription: Senior Full-Stack Engineer, Trading API (client-facing application) at Alpaca, a self-clearing broker-dealer and brokerage infrastructure company (9M+ brokerage accounts, $320M+ raised, Series D). Role owns frontend trading dashboards and backend systems for Trading API product features (elite, high-yield cash, paper accounts). Must-haves: 5+ years full-stack with Golang & TypeScript/React, TailwindCSS, PostgreSQL, REST APIs. Nice-to-haves: algo trading experience, GCP, financial markets understanding, Docker/Kubernetes, startup and remote experience.
_jobApplication.notes: Candidate note: no documented Golang, C#, or React experience in resume.md/resume.json (frontend history is Vue, backend is Java/Python/TypeScript). Tailored honestly per candidate direction: framed Vue/Java/TypeScript as the transferable full-stack foundation rather than claiming React or Golang. Leaned hard into the genuine differentiators the JD lists as nice-to-haves: personal algo trading (PulseView) and technical mentorship of OptAlpha (high-frequency algorithmic trading in production), 7+ years remote work, deep AI systems background, positioned as 'AI Full-Stack Engineer'. Recommend addressing the Golang/React gap directly and early in any recruiter screen.
